en.summary: LoopMatmulLdB now treats a zero B DRAM address as a reuse sentinel: it suppresses the pseudo-load, advances iterators only on real handshakes, and clears the one-shot flip flag after use.
why_it_counts: Patch changes `LoopMatmulLdB` state and issue logic in DUT RTL
It gates command emission on nonzero DRAM addresses and advances iterators only on a real fire
It also clears the one-shot B-reuse flip flag after the flip happens
evidence: LoopMatmulLdB adds `val b_dram_addr_null = (dram_addr === 0.U)` and gates `io.cmd.valid` with `!b_dram_addr_null`
Iterator updates are moved under `when (io.cmd.fire())` instead of the old `elsewhen (dram_addr === 0.U)` structure
The patch also adds `b_dram_new_null := false.B` after `flip_b_spad` to reset the one-shot reuse state

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a loop engine uses a special null or zero operand address to mean reuse of an already loaded buffer, the corresponding load FSM must not issue a memory transaction for that pseudo-load. It must also advance loop iterators only after a real memory-command handshake, and it must clear any one-shot reuse flag after the associated buffer flip happens. Otherwise the controller can emit bogus loads, skip or duplicate progress, or keep re-flipping a reuse buffer.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: null-address reuse handling in operand load sequencer
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A matmul loop requests operand-B reuse using a sentinel address instead of a real DRAM address.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Let the load FSM treat the sentinel address like a real load request and/or leave the one-shot reuse flag uncleared after the flip.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop sentinel guard on valid and state advance
portability_notes: This maps to any load sequencer where a special address or flag means buffer reuse rather than DMA.
The critical properties are command-valid generation, iterator advance rules, and post-flip state reset.
Another DUT may use an explicit reuse bit instead of a zero address, but the bug mechanism is the same.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the operand-load FSM for the reusable buffer.
Remove the guard that suppresses command valid when the address is the reuse sentinel.
Allow state progress to depend on the sentinel case instead of only on a real command handshake.
Do not clear the one-shot reuse flag after the buffer-bank flip or equivalent pointer swap occurs.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmulLdB zero-address handling and flip_b_spad reset
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix stops LOAD2 issuance for dram_addr === 0.U, keeps iterator movement tied to io.cmd.fire(), and clears b_dram_new_null after flip_b_spad fires.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore io.cmd.valid without the !b_dram_addr_null term, move state handling back toward the old dram_addr === 0.U path, and remove b_dram_new_null := false.B from the flip_b_spad block.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The controller can emit bogus zero-address B loads, mis-sequence or terminate the B-load loop incorrectly, or reuse the wrong B buffer because the flip state is not one-shot anymore.
evidence_for_injection: Zero address is explicitly recognized as a special case in LoopMatmulLdB after the fix.
The patch separates real load progress from the zero-address early-exit path.
The same commit resets b_dram_new_null after flip_b_spad, showing the reuse event is intended to fire once.
notes: This is the second half of the same zero-address B reuse bug sequence as dataset 131.
If you want a smaller mutation, removing only the post-flip reset yields a weaker but still real variant.

zh.summary: LoopMatmulLdB 现在会把零值 B DRAM 地址当作复用哨兵处理：它会抑制这类伪加载，只在真实握手时推进迭代器，并在使用后清除一次性的翻转标志。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 DUT RTL 中 `LoopMatmulLdB` 的状态机和发射逻辑
它只在 DRAM 地址非零时发射命令，并且仅在真实握手时推进迭代器
它还在翻转发生后清除了单次触发的 B 复用标志
evidence: LoopMatmulLdB 增加了 `val b_dram_addr_null = (dram_addr === 0.U)`，并用 `!b_dram_addr_null` 约束 `io.cmd.valid`
迭代器更新被移动到 `when (io.cmd.fire())` 下，不再使用旧的 `elsewhen (dram_addr === 0.U)` 结构
补丁还在 `flip_b_spad` 后加入了 `b_dram_new_null := false.B`，用于重置单次复用状态

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当循环引擎用特殊的空地址或零地址表示“复用已加载缓冲区”时，相应的加载状态机不应为这种伪加载发出真正的内存事务。它还必须只在真实的内存命令握手之后推进循环迭代器，并在相关缓冲区翻转完成后清除一次性复用标志。否则控制器可能发出伪加载、跳过或重复推进，或者持续重复翻转复用缓冲区。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 可复用操作数加载状态机中的空地址复用处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 matmul 循环通过哨兵地址请求复用操作数 B，而不是提供真实 DRAM 地址。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让加载状态机把这个哨兵地址当成真实加载请求处理，或者在翻转之后不清除一次性复用标志。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除对哨兵值的 valid 和状态推进保护
portability_notes: 这可以映射到任何使用特殊地址或标志表示缓冲区复用而不是 DMA 的加载状态机。
关键点是命令 valid 的生成、迭代器推进规则，以及翻转后的状态复位。
其他 DUT 也许用显式复用位而不是零地址，但缺陷机理相同。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位负责可复用缓冲区的操作数加载状态机。
删除当地址等于复用哨兵时抑制命令 valid 的保护条件。
让状态推进部分重新依赖哨兵情况，而不是只依赖真实命令握手。
在发生缓冲区 bank 翻转或等价指针切换后，不要清除一次性复用标志。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: LoopMatmulLdB 的零地址处理与 flip_b_spad 复位逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 dram_addr === 0.U 时停止发出 LOAD2，请求进度仅由 io.cmd.fire() 驱动，并在 flip_b_spad 触发后清除 b_dram_new_null。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复不带 !b_dram_addr_null 的 io.cmd.valid，让状态处理回到旧的 dram_addr === 0.U 路径，并从 flip_b_spad 块中删除 b_dram_new_null := false.B。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 控制器可能发出伪造的零地址 B 加载、错误推进或过早终止 B 加载循环，或者因为翻转状态不再是一次性的而复用到错误的 B 缓冲区。
evidence_for_injection: 修复后 LoopMatmulLdB 明确把零地址识别为特殊情况。
补丁把真实加载进度和零地址提前退出路径分离开来。
同一提交在 flip_b_spad 后重置 b_dram_new_null，说明复用事件本意上只应触发一次。
notes: 这是与数据集 131 同一零地址 B 复用缺陷序列的第二部分。
如果需要更小的变体，只删除翻转后的复位也能得到较弱但仍真实的故障。
